Title: Stability Protocol For Febus 80 F/C Tablet
Purpose: This protocol defines the procedure to conduct Stability Studies for Febus 80 mg F/C Tablets
Responsibilities:
QC is responsible for:

  • Preparation and review of stability protocol.
  • Collecting and storing stability samples.
  • Labeling of samples.
  • Initiation and withdrawal of samples.
  • Perform stability analysis.
  • Preparation of analysis report and trend data.
  • Initiating out-of-trend and out-of-specification investigation related to stability analysis (on requisite).
  • Initiating change control, deviation/incident related to stability analysis (on requisite).

VD&LCM is responsible for:

  • Review of the protocol.

QA is responsible for:

  • Review and approval of the protocol.
Reference: SOP of Stability Designing and Handling of Stability Protocol (000000650 & 000000530)
AnalysisReport: Analysis will be done as per stability specification and results shall be reported as per respective SOP (Testing and Reporting Result of Stability sample). Stability analysis should be initiated within 10 working days from the date of withdrawal and the analysis to be completed within 30 working days.
Reporting: The laboratory raw data shall be reviewed and test results are to be evaluated against the established acceptance criteria. Stability trend analysis shall be reviewed as part of periodic product quality evaluation.
Conclusion: At the end of the accelerated and long term stability study a summary report shall be prepared with the conclusion on the stability under the packing conditions and terminate the stability study
Note:
1. For Microbial Testing sample should be kept and withdrawn during 24 and 36 months at long term condition.
  2. Additional Study Sample will be pulled out and tested only if needed.
  3. The Placebo should be subjected to stability studies for the “Organic impurities test”. The Placebo samples should be withdrawn at each regular time interval.
  4. Placebo sample has incubated in a container bottle.
